business_problem: A modern, cloud-native solution was required so that scientists wouldn’t have to download petabytes of data locally, a prohibitively expensive and time-consuming barrier that would limit participation to only the most well-resourced institutions.
solution_summary: A modern, cloud-native solution was required so that scientists wouldn’t have to download petabytes of data locally, a prohibitively expensive and time-consuming barrier that would limit participation to only the most well-resourced institutions. Researchers can log into the Rubin Science Platform from a standard laptop and use familiar tools like Jupyter Notebooks and custom Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) to interact with the data.
